data.body:
[P3] Revisit the independent release-version policy

CONTRIBUTING rules 2 and 7 require explaining simpler alternatives and documenting additional decisions. The PR description explains neither this separate parser nor the major-version cap. The parser already diverges from the publisher: `1.1.0-rc.1+build.7` is supported by `parseSemver` and its tests, but fails this regex even with matching manifest and lockfile versions. Because publishing runs the full suite, this blocks a supported release. Return to the design phase (rule 8, step 6), consider using the existing release-validation policy, and document the chosen constraints and reasons for maintainer agreement.
